::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
::: {.callout-warning}
**Tutorial adalah prasyarat wajib untuk Individual Assignment minggu yang sama** - kalau belum dikerjakan, Individual Assignment tidak akan dinilai. Deadline Tutorial adalah hari Rabu sesi lab; deadline Individual Assignment adalah Senin minggu berikutnya. Lihat tanggal lengkap tiap minggu di [halaman Jadwal](../index.qmd#jadwal-semester).
:::

1. Setiap minggu, Senin adalah kelas materi dan Rabu adalah sesi lab tutorial. Tutorial harus diselesaikan pada sesi lab yang dijadwalkan (deadline-nya adalah hari Rabu itu sendiri).
2. Tutorial **tidak dinilai** secara langsung, tapi menjadi **prasyarat wajib** untuk Individual Assignment minggu yang sama - kalau Tutorial minggu itu belum diselesaikan, Individual Assignment yang bersangkutan **tidak akan dinilai**, meskipun sudah dikumpulkan.
3. Mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen selama jam sesi lab.
4. Individual Assignment dirilis Senin (minggu yang sama dengan Tutorial-nya), dengan tenggat waktu Senin minggu **berikutnya** - jadi lebih lama dari deadline Tutorial-nya sendiri (lihat menu Tugas).
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
::: {.callout-warning}
**A Tutorial is a mandatory prerequisite for that same week's Individual Assignment** - if it hasn't been completed, the Individual Assignment won't be graded. A Tutorial's deadline is its Wednesday lab session; its Individual Assignment's deadline is the following Monday. See exact dates for every week on the [Schedule page](../index.qmd#semester-schedule).
:::

1. Every week, Monday is the lecture and Wednesday is the tutorial lab session. Tutorials must be completed during the scheduled lab session (its deadline is that same Wednesday).
2. Tutorials are **not graded** directly, but are a **mandatory prerequisite** for that same week's Individual Assignment - if that week's Tutorial hasn't been completed, the corresponding Individual Assignment **will not be graded**, even if submitted.
3. Students may ask teaching assistants questions during the lab session.
4. Individual Assignments are released on Monday (the same week as their Tutorial), with a deadline the **following** Monday - later than the Tutorial's own deadline (see the Assignments menu).
:::
